articles.summary: Sell-through rate is units sold over units received. With 15.8% of US retail sales returned in 2025, learn the formula, honest benchmarks, and how to act on it.
articles.title: Sell-through rate: formula, benchmarks, and how to use it

articles.summary: US clothing stores held about 61 days of sales in stock in August 2026, grocers about 25. Here is what a good DIO for retail looks like and how to judge yours.
articles.title: What is a good DIO for retail? Benchmarks by sub-sector
